operational_rule: Select only cases where new evidence could change or materially de-risk a concrete frozen decision.
acceptance_check: Each SELECT row has decision_at_stake + expected_information_gain + non-NO_CHANGE counterfactual.

operational_rule: Freeze ordinary Search/Search-only baseline before any AI evidence.
failure_policy: Reject candidate with no recoverable baseline.

operational_rule: Tie expected information gain to observable GenSearch answer/source/refined-query fields.
failure_policy: Reject when uncertainty cannot be informed by these observables.
acceptance_check: ai_observability_fit != LOW and future_evidence_question names observable.

operational_rule: Make INSUFFICIENT a first-class outcome; do not force a decision from weak/no evidence.
failure_policy: Keep Search-only baseline if future evidence is insufficient.

operational_rule: Do not use GenSearch to replace business truth, private analytics, or first-party history.
failure_policy: REJECT or HOLD with required source named.

operational_rule: Cover distinct uncertainty families before adding repeat cases.
failure_policy: Second same-family case requires control rationale.
acceptance_check: No duplicate family among SELECT without CONTROL_REPEAT.

operational_rule: Keep decision leverage, uncertainty, observability and diversity separate instead of magic score.
acceptance_check: Required ordinal fields present on all reviewed candidates.

operational_rule: Keep selection small and auditable; current product default normally 3–10.
Prefer cases where competing evidence surfaces plausibly discriminate page/user-job responsibilities.
failure_policy: Do not infer ranking facts from analogy.
acceptance_check: Selection reason describes decision discrimination, not ranking claim.

operational_rule: Treat GenSearch as official generative-search evidence, not consumer Alice replay.
Step 15 selects cases only; acquisition belongs to separately gated Step 16.
failure_policy: Any provider call means Step15 pre-step gate failure.

operational_rule: Because Step15 is UNVALIDATED, present method before case-selection execution.
failure_policy: Stop with execution_authorized=false until owner acceptance.
